profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Intuit
profile.summary:
Graduated Bachelor Degree and Master's degree in Computer Science  from University of California San Diego. 
Tutor at UCSD Computer Science and Engineering Department. 
Strong Knowledge in Java, C++, C, JS, and advanced data structure.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Finetch - Payment Platform. 
- Lead the end-to-end development of a real-time fraud detection pipeline for QuickBooks Payments. When a payer opens an invoice, a backend service captures device, geolocation, and account metadata and persists it to DynamoDB, while a JavaScript SDK embedded in the invoice UI streams behavioral signals — mouse movement, copy-paste actions, and keystroke patterns — to ML models that compute a running risk score. At payment time, the risk service pulls the pre-staged data alongside the latest ML score and runs it through a rules-based decision engine to approve or decline transactions in real time.
- As an engineer on the Decision Engine team, I helped architect and develop the Business Rules Engine used to detect and prevent fraudulent transactions across Intuit Payments — protecting the platform against fraud across millions of daily transactions and preventing millions of dollars in annual fraud losses across QuickBooks Payments and Payroll.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Woking as a backend engineer on the QuickBooks Payment team.
- Designed and implemented REST API for QuickBooks Payment team for all Wallet Cash transactions to identify fraudulent transactions
- Worked on the Tax Engine platform team to develop new capabilities for clients to call formsmode API

positions.title: Graduate Teacher Assistant
positions.description: CSE 12/15L (Basic Data Structures and Object-Oriented Design and Software Tools and Techniques Laboratory. assisting students in the implementation of basic data structures such as stacks, linked lists, queues, hash tables and binary trees. As well as the basics of Git, Vim, gdb, writing test-cases, Eclipse, Makefiles and Valgrind.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern

Working with the TurboTax on Tax Engine platform team. Developing new

positions.title: Graduate Researcher
positions.description:
Working on WIFIRE project. 
Working on building an App that allows the user to take pictures of fire or smoke and upload to server, as well as viewing of all uploaded images.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Working with the mobile application team(Android and IOS). Developing on Disney Gif and Star Wars IPhone and Android Applications. Implemented the share screen functionality and UI part that allows user to share with friends. Also implemented the ad targeting to serve ad for each category separately.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description: Project: Slicing, feature extraction, and clustering the satellite Images. Creating a workflow to do future extraction and clustering.

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor

Helping students in the implementation of basic data structures such as
stacks, linked lists, and queues as well as advanced structures such as hash
tables and binary trees.
Lab Assistant: Helping and teaching students the basic of git, Vim, GDB, writing test-cases, Eclipse, Makefiles and Valgrind.

projects.title: Boggle Game
projects.description: I implemented this game in one of my computer science class as one of our projects. Using recursion, sorting, Dijkstra, mapping and dynamic programming.

projects.title: Tetris Game
projects.description:
As one of project for the class we had to write a Tetris game. 
Designed and implemented Tetris application using C++ where a user can play against the computer.

organizations.name: ALPHA GAMA SIGMA
organizations.description: I joined this organization while when i was in Santa Monica College. AGS is a statewide honor society that promotes both scholastic achievement and community service.

organizations.name: PHI THETA KAPPA
organizations.description: PTK are given a platform to participate in community service events, networking conventions, leadership seminars, scholarship opportunities, and finally fellowshipping with other members.
